issues.detail: The Hebrew 'בֵּית אֵל בְּרִית' (Beth-El Berith, i.e., the house/temple of El-Berith, a Canaanite god) is rendered as 'đền thờ của thần Bê-ri' (temple of the god Beri). This changes the divine name 'El-Berith' (God of the Covenant) into a single deity 'Bê-ri', dropping 'El' and altering the proper name.
